sns.boxenplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=df, ax=ax1, palette="coolwarm")

ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('$%.2f'))

ax3.set_xlabel('Is Fraudulent Transaction', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_xticklabels(['No', 'Yes'])
ax3.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('$%.2f'))


# --- Plot 4: Scatter Plot of Amount vs. Hour, Highlighting Fraud ---
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
